name: agent-webmcp
description: Operate Agent WebMCP's canonical service, agent, discovery, and durable-job workflows while preserving its bounded WebMCP and MCP authority surfaces.

interface.shortDescription: Operate bounded services, agents, discovery, and durable jobs
interface.longDescription: Understand and operate Agent WebMCP's canonical runtime without inventing a second execution model. The plugin covers managed-service inspection and lifecycle, deterministic and optional Codex-assisted discovery, durable service jobs, runtime Agent Registry monitoring, the browser-native WebMCP projection, and the intentionally narrower remote MCP projection.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current Agent WebMCP system, agents, and managed-service health.
Discover operator services safely and explain which candidates were accepted or rejected.
Inspect durable Agent WebMCP jobs, their execution trace, logs, and agent attribution.
